test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 25 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

The library building was renovated in 2020.

options.text: They were renovating the building in 2020.
They had renovated the library building in 2020.
They renovated the library building in 2020.
They did renovating the building in 2020.

solution:
The correct answer is "**They renovated the library building in 2020.**"
